title: Sensor Coverage under Structured Failures
description: Version 3 research revision. We study the part of a sensor field that remains covered after every failure in a prescribed downward-closed family. The model includes independent contact failures, weighted failure budgets and losses of entire fault domains. For a convex sensor cover with nerve N, we express the surviving region by a complex on the maximal faces of N: a collection of maximal faces is a simplex exactly when its common contact set cannot fail. This is a coverage formulation of classical nerve and Dowker duality, for which we give explicit comparison maps and prove naturality under increasing failure families. For n closed planar disks, all maximal nerve faces are witnessed by at most n^2 circle points. Exact rational sign tests consequently construct the full two-skeleton of the dual model without enumerating the original nerve or the coalition shadow. A separate Lipschitz margin theorem gives continuous coverage certificates for prescribed triangulated targets under the same failure rules. Recomputing five supplied fields completes the previously unfinished dense example: its two-fold covered region has Betti numbers (5,6), calculated from a dual complex with 130 vertices and independently checked boundary rank. The implementation, inputs, exact arithmetic conventions and verification records are supplied.
